text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle scores a magnificent<n>victory, eliciting
celebratory cheers<n>and thunderous applause from
the<n>stands!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By defeating the mighty Silence<n>Suzuka and scoring
victories in three<n>G1 sprints, Taiki has undoubtedly
demonstrated her star potential.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After dominating all of her races, she<n>only has one
goal<n>remaining—becoming the next<n>Umamusume of
the Year!
